# Parley v0.1.4

This corrective beta makes opening folders transactional and safely recovers
shell workspaces left unclassified by older releases.

## Fixed

- Opening a folder no longer fails with **“tmux did not return the new
  workspace ids”** after tmux has already created the window.
- New windows use a unique provisional identity. If tmux's direct response is
  empty, Parley reconciles the exact live window, completes its metadata and
  presents the requested workspace normally.
- If that reconciliation is ambiguous, Parley removes only its own incomplete
  provisional window instead of leaking an invisible workspace or guessing at
  an existing one.
- On startup, a lone live shell in an unclassified private Parley window is
  recovered by writing metadata only. The process, scrollback and working
  directory are preserved. Agent-looking and multi-pane windows are left
  untouched.

## Verification

- The failure paths are covered by native regression checks for missing tmux
  output, exact cleanup after ambiguous recovery and shell-only legacy
  adoption.
- The release runs the complete native, packaging, security, public-history and
  VS Code companion checks before producing its draft assets.

## Install and upgrade

- Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later.
- `tmux` and at least one supported, installed and signed-in vendor CLI.
- Download `Parley-0.1.4-mac-arm64.dmg`, quit Parley, replace `Parley.app` in
  Applications, and reopen it.
- Existing tmux panes, workspace folders, layouts, context and collaboration
  history remain under `~/Library/Application Support/Parley Native`.
- This beta is ad-hoc signed and is **not notarized**. Use **System Settings →
  Privacy & Security → Open Anyway** only when the files came from this expected
  release. Never disable Gatekeeper globally.

Use `Parley-0.1.4-mac-arm64.SHA256SUMS` to verify every downloaded artifact.
